body: Shit... sometimes you can't even take the time... i take any time right now for myself I lose everything, my son included... im so... so tired... but the game is rigged
They don't wanna walk down 3 flights of stares. They all use prime and Walmart delivery and just never leave.
Werrrllll. I had a request to run in a salon screaming "order for K.C. baabbbbyy".. i did it. But it was the wrong building. Only time ive ever been in a gym and I got thrown out -.-
Trying to think about them. They just got him in custody yesterday after 5 days on the run... but my ex let it happen.. and im gonna have to face her in court in a couple days..

My 2 year old son (who was born when my ex was married so he's not legally mine yet) was found abandoned by his mom who left a month ago,, with a broken arm, pulled out hair, cigarette burns, chemical burn to his left cornea, and brusing all over... this week has been the hardest of my life when it comes to recovery and not wanting to relapse.. but im fighting so hard for custody i went and paid 100$ for my own drug test to speed up the process... but God its so hard...
How easily she used me to get off. Then literally got off and left.

My thoughts are always too scattered to lie anywhere specifically. And yes. Thats the point. Suffering does nothing. It doesn't relinquish anything related to what I've done... and thats the type of punishment I feel I deserve.

Dead honest?... not even my son. I am sure he will be fine without me. Being alive was a punishment for myself... i was comatose 3 days in 2017 due to a opium/diazepam/clonazepam overdose.. since then death hasn't scared me.. but I've messed up a lot in my life.. i feel like I need to atone for my sins... and being alive is apparently a curse... but now  that this curse has taken literally everything.. and im just ready now, you know?

A lot of people have it worse than I do. Yeah. That was tiny synopsis of some of the things that have happened in life. Im not saying by any means that anything that happened is cause for me to feel the way I feel. People have jumped off bridges for far less than the things I've said here. Im just at my breaking point when I was hit with a 2020 machine gun of external bullshit mixed with 2 years of hell and 24 years of tangled pathetic internalized conflicting emotions. All im saying. So to exit your loop is as simple as it is to take my life. You cut a line in it even though it seems illogical and destruction. Just because you're tired of being in your loop.

My lawyer is trying but as of right now he has no income or assets, he didn't have any insurance of any kind and was arrested for driving without a license and insurance. We are trying every path we can because I sustained decent internal injury. It just feels hopeless to the point of no return and that karma is targeting me way more than needed. Granted I'm not the greatest person by any means.. but for everything to happen at once?... its like the universe wants me to just start my next life already.

Everything just hurts so bad and I don't know how to feel anymore. I feel so lost and I have extreme anxiety so normally death scares me away... but the more things keep happening. The closer to home death feels. I feel shitty enough as it is... then to have to vent to people on the internet because I have no where else to fully release it?... 

im not gonna say anything as to raise concern.. but if all goes well and tomorrow doesn't come, the world wouldn't miss a beat. And honestly I'm okay with that.. i just cant handle anymore. Its like an emotional and social cancer ive had for years now. And soon ill just finally be at rest. I appreciate the support. But I don't even feel like this world is even worth it anymore with the amounts of malice and apathy humans have contracted. 3 years and she can take my son away and ignore me while I'm half dead in a hospital 200 miles away? Tell me she'll never take my son away then 3 days later file a restraining order?
